text_markup: Many abilities require players to choose 1 or more objects or subroutines to affect. Each object and subroutine chosen for an ability is a {term:target} of that ability.
text_plain: Many abilities require players to choose 1 or more objects or subroutines to affect. Each object and subroutine chosen for an ability is a target of that ability.

examples.text_markup: {card:Top Hat} reads in part, "you may choose 1 of the top 5 cards of R&D and access it." The target of this instruction is the card in R&D the Runner chooses.
examples.text_plain: Top Hat reads in part, "you may choose 1 of the top 5 cards of R&D and access it." The target of this instruction is the card in R&D the Runner chooses.

examples.text_markup: One of the subroutines on {card:Colossus} reads in part, "Trash 1 installed program and 1 installed resource." The targets of this subroutine are the two cards that will be trashed.
examples.text_plain: One of the subroutines on Colossus reads in part, "Trash 1 installed program and 1 installed resource." The targets of this subroutine are the two cards that will be trashed.

examples.text_markup: {card:Trick of Light} reads, "Choose 1 installed card you can advance. Move up to 2 advancement counters from 1 other card to the chosen card." The targets of this operation are the advancement counters to be moved and the destination card. If 2 tokens are chosen, they must be hosted on the same card.
examples.text_plain: Trick of Light reads, "Choose 1 installed card you can advance. Move up to 2 advancement counters from 1 other card to the chosen card." The targets of this operation are the advancement counters to be moved and the destination card. If 2 tokens are chosen, they must be hosted on the same card.

examples.text_markup: The Runner is encountering a {subtype:barrier} and uses {card:Cleaver} to break subroutines. The targets of {card:Cleaver}'s' interface ability are the 1 or 2 subroutines that it will break.
examples.text_plain: The Runner is encountering a barrier and uses Cleaver to break subroutines. The targets of Cleaver's' interface ability are the 1 or 2 subroutines that it will break.
